description: This file defines the AnsiTypeCoercion object which implements type coercion rules for Spark SQL in ANSI mode, including type precedence, implicit casting, and handling of complex data types.

classes.name: AnsiTypeCoercion
classes.description: Object implementing ANSI mode type coercion rules for Spark SQL, including type precedence, implicit casting, and complex type handling.

classes.name: AnsiCombinedTypeCoercionRule
classes.description: Class for combining multiple type coercion rules to be applied together.

methods.name: findTightestCommonType
methods.description: Determines the most specific common data type between two types based on precedence rules.

methods.name: findWiderTypeForTwo
methods.description: Finds a wider data type that can accommodate both input types.

methods.name: findWiderCommonType
methods.description: Finds a common supertype for a sequence of data types.

methods.name: implicitCast
methods.description: Attempts to implicitly cast an expression to an expected type under ANSI rules.

methods.name: canCast
methods.description: Checks if casting from one data type to another is allowed under ANSI rules.
